title: The flat on Charlotte, a lost puppy and rent-party fish suppers
summary: He lived near the church, lost his first dog in a fall, and listened to music at fish suppers and rent parties.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: 'Cause I didn't live but two...three blocks from the church. Church was on Charlotte--a street called Charlotte--[ ] Charlotte. I live about two...three blocks up the street in a big old flat. I fell down them steps for many a day. And I used to be crazy about dogs. So a man had a bunch of spitz dogs. He raised them. So I used to go up there and help him feed 'em. So he told me one day he gonna give me a dog. He finally got around to it. He give me a nice little puppy. I live on the third floor in the flat so while I hadn't got out of bed that mornin', my mom let the dog out on the porch. It fell off the porch and killed itself. I cried like a baby. That was the first little pet I ever had, and I thought that the world and all of that little dog.

And then we used to have...they used to have fish suppers, and people give rent parties and it...on a weekend, so they serve hot fish ...chicken...stuff like that. So my brother-in-law, he played the piano so he used to bring it along with him sometimes. A lady used to have a place like that. She was a...always...she had a son was sickly so she let me come and play with him all the time. So when they had a fish Friday an' Saturday night, I be in a...we be in upstairs room with her son, an' we just sit on the steps and listen...and watch the people dance and listen to the music.
